purpose: Clinical research to improve prevention and health service planning.
question: We need the mean latest systolic pressure, in millimetres of mercury, for adults with a recorded stroke, plus the number measured; please do not substitute the diastolic reading.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
Stroke means a condition code beginning I63.
Use each adult’s latest observation through 31 December 2025 with LOINC 8480-6.
No grouping; mean to one decimal. Metrics: systolic_measured and systolic_mean.
